summary: The page layout generally aligns with the design system, but exhibits localization inconsistencies and background scroll handling defects when the modal dialog is active.

issues.title: Untranslated step counter label
issues.description: The questionnaire step indicator displays English copy within an otherwise localized Hebrew interface.
issues.evidence: Header shows English text 'Question 1 of 3' alongside Hebrew headings.
issues.suggestion: Localize the progress indicator text to match the active locale.

issues.title: Incomplete modal overlay coverage
issues.description: The dialog overlay does not lock body scrolling, exposing unmasked page content below the initial viewport fold.
issues.evidence: AssistantMessage card below the fold appears outside the backdrop dimming layer.
issues.suggestion: Lock background scrolling and extend modal backdrop across the entire document height.
